_source: Derived from OpenCC's Traditional-to-Simplified CHARACTER dictionary, data/dictionary/TSCharacters.txt at commit 56d028aa324c407a51b74da7891450e408432569 (2026-07-07), Apache-2.0. https://github.com/BYVoid/OpenCC
_rule: A character is listed here if and only if OpenCC maps it to one or more simplified forms and NONE of those forms is the character itself. That is the only honest mechanical definition of "Traditional leaked into a Simplified cell": the character HAS a distinct simplified form, so a Simplified text would have used that form instead. OpenCC's 945 keys whose target list INCLUDES the key (U+7947, U+77AD and friends) are deliberately absent -- Simplified retains them in some contexts, so their presence is not evidence of a leak. Characters OpenCC does not map at all (U+808F, U+8137) are the same character in both scripts and are absent too.
_coverage: 3137 of OpenCC's 4148 keys: the ones inside the BMP Han ranges G-SCRIPT walks (U+3400-U+4DBF, U+4E00-U+9FFF, U+F900-U+FAFF). 66 keys in CJK Extension B and beyond are omitted because script_findings never visits those code points. This is not exhaustive Unicode and does not claim to be: it is a leak DETECTOR, and a Traditional character OpenCC does not map would pass. It replaces a GB2312-encodability test that both over-reported (8 of 9 hits on the 2026-08-27 Chinese wave were rare Simplified characters, not Traditional) and under-reported (54 table entries, U+5F8C among them, ARE GB2312-encodable and were invisible to it).
_regenerate: curl -sSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BYVoid/OpenCC/master/data/dictionary/TSCharacters.txt, drop comment lines, split each line on TAB into key and space-separated targets, keep key -> "".join(targets) where the key is not among its own targets and the key is in the BMP Han ranges above. Bump _source to the commit you took it from.
_note_not_overlayable: This file is package data read straight by gates.py, NOT a registry file a work/registry/ overlay can layer onto. The overlayable numbers are the BASELINE COUNTS in gates.json; what "Traditional" MEANS is not a per-run policy knob, and a run that could redefine it could silently unblock a real leak.
